# Glossary

| Term | Definition | Examples from this document |
|---|---|---|
| **Cross-reference (xref) or membership table** | A table summarising assessments of fuzzy membership of units in a source classification to units in a target classification. | `membership_tbl`; see @sec-input-memb and @sec-formats. |
| **Lookup table (`lookup_tbl`)** | Controlled vocabulary listing all valid unit IDs, names, and conceptual eligibility flags (`eligible = TRUE/FALSE`) for a source or target classification. | `TASVEG` and `IUCN_GET`; see @sec-lookup. |
| **Source** | The classification being cross-referenced *from*. | TASVEG 5.0, Tasmania's vegetation classification and map; see @sec-source. |
| **Source unit** | One ecological concept or mapping unit of the source classification, assessed independently. | Vegetation communities in TASVEG 5.0; see @sec-source. |
| **Source unit id / Source id** | Unique identifier for each unit in the source classification. | `VEGCODE` column in the TASVEG lookup table (@sec-lookup). |
| **Target** | The classification being cross-referenced *to*. | IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (IUCN GET); see @sec-alignment. |
| **Target unit** | One unit of the target classification. | Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Groups (EFGs) of IUCN GET; see @sec-alignment. |
| **Target unit id / Target id** | Unique identifier for each target unit. | `EFG` or `efg_id` columns (realm + biome + group, e.g. `T2.6` terrestrial, `F2.2` freshwater, `MT2.1` marine–terrestrial, `TF1.7` terrestrial–freshwater wetland, `MFT1.3` marine–freshwater–terrestrial). |
| **Interpreter** | A domain expert who provides fuzzy membership assessments during elicitation. | Referred to as `interpreter` or `expert` interchangeably (`AK`, `AL`, `DAK`, `JB`, `MGT`); see @sec-input-memb. |
| **Membership** | An interpreter's fuzzy estimate [@Zadeh_1965] of the relationship between a source unit and a target unit on $[0, 1]$, where 0 means excluded and 1 means unambiguous membership. | `memb` column; see @sec-input-memb and @sec-formats. |
| **Assigned / not assigned** | Targets given positive membership ($> 0$) by an interpreter are *assigned* (summing to 1 per source unit). Other candidate targets not listed by that interpreter for an assessed unit are *not assigned* (implicit membership 0). | See @sec-input-memb and @sec-round-one. |
| **Not assessed** | The interpreter provided no record for the source unit in that round; kept as `NA` in `membership_matrix` and never filled with 0. | E.g. 55 units not assessed by `Jayne_Balmer` in Round 1 (@sec-round-one). |
| **Record** | One interpreter's membership estimate for one `(source, target, round)` combination (one row in long format). | See @sec-input-memb. |
| **Profile** | An interpreter's full membership vector for one source unit across all candidate targets considered for that unit. | Used in `calc_agreement()` and `calc_shannons_entropy()`. |
| **Membership matrix** | 3D numeric array `[source, target, interpreter]` produced by `ecoSynthesis::membership_matrix()`, with 0 for unused targets and `NA` for unassessed units. | `TASVEG_mtx_r1`, `TASVEG_mtx_r2`; see @sec-round-one and @sec-formats. |
| **Dissimilarity** | Half-$L_1$ distance between two interpreters' profiles for a unit: $D = \frac{1}{2}\sum_k |a_k - b_k|$ (equivalent to Bray–Curtis dissimilarity for unit-sum vectors; 0 = identical, 1 = no overlap). | `dissimilarity` in `calc_agreement()`; see @sec-round-one. |
| **Agreement / Similarity** | Complement of dissimilarity: $S = 1 - D$ (1 = identical profiles, 0 = no shared target membership). | `similarity`, `mean_similarity` in `calc_agreement()`; see @sec-round-one. |
| **Identical** | Two profiles with dissimilarity below `0.001`. | `share_identical` in `calc_agreement()`. |
| **Expert pair** | Two interpreters compared on the same source unit (6 pairs among 4 interpreters in Round 1; 10 pairs among 5 interpreters in Round 2). | `interpreter_x`, `interpreter_y`. |
| **Contested unit** | A source unit with high mean pairwise dissimilarity across interpreter pairs. | E.g. `FMG`, `FSM`, `SWR`; see @sec-round-one and @sec-round-two. |
| **Shannon's entropy (normalised)** | Information-theoretic measure of within-interpreter fuzziness/ambiguity on $[0, 1]$, normalised by $\log_2(N)$ under interpreter ($S$), source ($N_{\text{source}}$), or set ($N_{\text{set}}$) bases [@Shannon_1948; @Pielou_1966]. | `calc_shannons_entropy()`, `calc_entropy_tbl()`; see @sec-round-one–@sec-between-rounds. |
| **Proportion of membership (`prop_memb`)** | Aggregated share of total Round 2 membership votes across interpreters assigned to a target EFG for a source unit. | `summarise_membership()`; see @sec-synthesis. |
| **Supporting interpreters (`supporting`)** | Number of interpreters (out of `total_interp`) who assigned positive membership ($> 0$) to a candidate EFG for a source unit. | `summarise_membership()`; see @sec-synthesis and @sec-maps. |
| **Data checks** | Non-destructive validation diagnostics checking numeric type, missing values, $[0, 1]$ bounds, source eligibility, and target validity. | `check_membership()`; see @sec-valid. |
